name: escala
description: Escala conversational agent (text + voice): airline disruption rebooking, handoff and FAQ over a mock backend

variableDeclarations.name: channel
variableDeclarations.description: Session channel, text or voice. Optional; used for tone only.

variableDeclarations.name: active_pnr
variableDeclarations.description: Booking code (PNR) of the identified booking. Set by the after-tool callback on a successful lookupBooking.

variableDeclarations.name: offered_quotes
variableDeclarations.description: JSON object mapping each quote_id offered by the latest getRebookingOptions to its expires_at. Set by the after-tool callback; never set in evals.

variableDeclarations.name: offered_totals
variableDeclarations.description: JSON object mapping each offered quote_id to its payment.total_ars. Set by the after-tool callback together with offered_quotes; never set in evals.

variableDeclarations.name: confirmed_quote_id
variableDeclarations.description: quote_id the passenger explicitly confirmed. Set by record_quote_confirmation, cleared when options are re-fetched or the rebooking is executed; never set in evals.

variableDeclarations.name: confirmed_total_ars
variableDeclarations.description: Total in ARS the passenger confirmed together with confirmed_quote_id, stored as a string. Never set in evals.

variableDeclarations.name: session_outcome
variableDeclarations.description: Analytics outcome of the session: resolved, handed_off or failed.

variableDeclarations.name: _disclaimer_shown
variableDeclarations.description: Internal flag, the string true once the experimental disclaimer was spoken. Never set in evals.

variableDeclarations.name: fsm_state
variableDeclarations.description: Conversation FSM state: IDENTIFY, TRIAGE, FAQ, OPTIONS, CONFIRM, DONE, HANDOFF or FAILURE. Computed by the after-tool callback track_state from tool results, never by the LLM; empty means IDENTIFY. Never set in evals.

variableDeclarations.name: fsm_failures
variableDeclarations.description: Consecutive retryable tool errors counted by track_state (two move the FSM to FAILURE). Never set in evals.

variableDeclarations.name: fsm_instructions
variableDeclarations.description: Step text of the current fsm_state, injected into the agent instructions as {fsm_instructions}. Written by the after-tool callback track_state right after each transition (step texts keyed by agent and state, target agent's text after transfer_to_agent); the default is the root IDENTIFY step. Never set in evals.

schema.default:
Paso actual: identificar la reserva.
1. Primer mensaje: saludá brevemente y preguntá en qué lo podés ayudar; si ya contó su situación, retomala sin pedírsela de nuevo.
2. Si habla de su reserva, un vuelo cancelado o demorado, un cambio o su equipaje y el código de reserva activo está vacío: pedí código de reserva y apellido de cualquier pasajero en la misma pregunta y usá escala_api_lookupBooking con last_name y pnr tal como los dijo. Si el código activo ya tiene valor, derivá a disruption_rebooking_agent.
3. BOOKING_NOT_FOUND: pedile que revise el código una vez. Si sigue sin aparecer, pedí de a una cosa apellido, fecha del vuelo y ruta, y usá escala_api_lookupBooking con last_name, flight_date, origin y destination. Si tampoco aparece, ofrecé una persona (reason user_request, sin pnr). Si corrige un dato, avisá y repetí la consulta.
4. Pregunta general: escala_api_searchFaq en español; respondé en una a tres oraciones con la fuente; si verified es false, agregá que hay que confirmarlo en aerolineas.com.ar; sin resultados, decí que no tenés información confiable y ofrecé una persona.
